title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1996 reported in the country during 1994-1996. The above 8 States recorded 1 Violent crime out of every 5 IPC crimes reported in the State/UT during this period. On the whole, the number of States/UTs which registered higher share of violent crimes over the national average share of violent crimes were: 15 States/UTs in 1994, 12 States/UTs in 1995 and 14 States/UTs in 1996. The following 12 States/UTs viz. Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Jammu & Kashmir, Manipur, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Rajasthan, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Daman & Diu recorded higher percentage of violent crimes than the national average for violent crimes to the total IPC crimes reported during the last 3 years (1994-1996).
